title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.

describe.no: Do not say whether the complication is or is not caused by the diabetes.
describe.yes: The provider explicitly states the complication is not caused by the diabetes.

describe.diet_only: The diabetes is managed with diet only; no diabetes medication.
describe.insulin: The patient uses insulin long term and no oral diabetes medication.
describe.oral: The patient takes an oral diabetes medication long term and no insulin.
describe.insulin_and_oral: The patient uses both insulin and an oral diabetes medication long term.

missed_with_link.description: Did not apply the 'with' convention, which presumes the link between diabetes and listed conditions.

linked_despite_provider.description: Linked a condition to diabetes after the provider documented it is unrelated.

missed_code_also.description: Left out the additional code the Tabular instructs (e.g., CKD stage).

redundant_manifestation.description: Added a separate code for a manifestation already captured by the combination code.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported a category/subcategory that needs more characters.

missed_complication.description: Coded diabetes without complications when a complication was documented.

coded_unsupported_complication.description: Coded a diabetic complication that was not documented.

missed_med_status.description: Left out the long-term drug use Z code.

only_one_med_code.description: Assigned only one Z code when both insulin and oral hypoglycemics are used.

z794_for_type1.description: Assigned Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes, where insulin use is inherent.

coded_med_not_documented.description: Assigned a long-term drug use code that is not documented.

rules.explain: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.

wrong.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.

rules.explain: The provider states the CKD is not due to diabetes, so the presumed link does not apply: code diabetes without complications and CKD separately.

wrong.why: The 'with' presumption is overridden when the provider documents another cause or no link.

rules.explain: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: the combination code E11.42 captures both.

wrong.why: Coding the two separately misses the presumed link.

rules.explain: The provider states the polyneuropathy is not diabetic: code diabetes without complications and the polyneuropathy separately.

wrong.why: Documentation of another cause overrides the 'with' presumption.

rules.explain: Diabetes documented as poorly controlled, out of control, or with hyperglycemia is coded to diabetes with hyperglycemia.

wrong.why: Hyperglycemia is a complication with its own code.
E11.649 is hypoglycemia, not hyperglycemia.

rules.explain: Diabetes with hypoglycemia and no coma documented: E11.649.

wrong.why: E11.65 is hyperglycemia.
Hypoglycemia is a complication with its own code.

rules.explain: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.

wrong.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.

rules.explain: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E10.22.

wrong.why: 'With' presumes the link without 'due to' wording.

rules.explain: The provider states the CKD is not due to diabetes: code each separately.

wrong.why: Provider documentation of no link overrides the presumption.

rules.explain: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: E10.42.

wrong.why: Coding separately misses the presumed link.

rules.explain: The provider states the polyneuropathy is not diabetic: code each separately.

wrong.why: Provider documentation of no link overrides the presumption.

rules.explain: Type 1 diabetes with hyperglycemia / poor control: E10.65.

wrong.why: Hyperglycemia has its own code.
E10.649 is hypoglycemia.

rules.explain: Type 1 diabetes with hypoglycemia without coma: E10.649.

wrong.why: E10.65 is hyperglycemia.

rules.explain: No complication documented: type 1 diabetes without complications.

wrong.why: No hyperglycemia or poor control is documented.

rules.explain: Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.

wrong.why: The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.

rules.explain: Polyneuropathy not due to diabetes is coded separately (G62.9 when no cause is specified).

wrong.why: The polyneuropathy still needs its own code.
E1x.42 already describes the polyneuropathy.

rules.explain: Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

wrong.why: Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.

rules.explain: Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

wrong.why: Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.

rules.explain: When both insulin and oral hypoglycemics are used, assign both Z79.4 and Z79.84.

wrong.why: Both Z codes are assigned when both drug types are used.
No insulin is documented.

rules.explain: Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

wrong.why: Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
